data.title: Fast Notes support
data.lead: Paste a chat message, snap a notice or just speak. Fast Notes pulls out events, reminders, notes and phone numbers and adds them to your Calendar and Contacts.
data.sub: On-device AI, works offline, understands the lunar calendar. Free for 3 months.

rate.label: Email
rate.note: Include your device, app version and the text you pasted so we can help faster.

data.title: Frequently asked questions.
data.intro: Need help? Email crosstechedu@gmail.com with your device, app version and a screenshot.

items.title: Does Fast Notes upload my messages?
items.body: No. The AI and the parser run on your phone. There is no account and no server that receives your content.

items.title: Which devices get on-device AI?
items.body: iPhones with Apple Intelligence (iOS 26 or later) and Android phones with Gemini Nano. Other devices use the offline parser, which still understands dates and the lunar calendar.

items.title: Which languages are supported?
items.body: Vietnamese, English, Portuguese, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Indonesian and Arabic.

items.title: How long is the free trial?
items.body: 3 months, with no payment details. After that Premium costs USD 9.99 per month (local prices vary). Cancel anytime in the App Store or Google Play.

items.title: How do I get a refund?
items.body: Payments are handled by Apple or Google, so request refunds from the store. If something is wrong with Premium, email us.
